name: counts
description:
One count per phrase, in a new column `<column>_<what>`.

what: "words" and "chars" — the words and the characters of the phrase; "count" — how many times the same phrase stands in the core; "number" — which occurrence of it this row is (1 for the first). Phrases are the same in any case and with ё as е; an empty cell has no count (an empty value). "share" — the cumulative share of the sum of `weight` (0..1) in row order; "share_of_total" — the value over the sum; both are rounded to 4 decimals and empty when the sum is 0. "abc" — the class by the cumulative share from the heaviest phrase down: "A" up to 80 %, "B" up to 95 %, "C" the rest. "share", "share_of_total" and "abc" need `weight`.
weight: the column of numbers to share (a frequency), for "share", "share_of_total" and "abc".

Example: semkit read --text "купить диван недорого" --text "диван" counts words write -
-> купить диван недорого, 3, 3; диван, 1, 1
Example: semkit read --text "купить диван" --text "диван" --text "диван" counts count write -
-> купить диван, 1, 1; диван, 2, 2; диван, 2, 2

The step writes the count of each phrase to a new column <column>_count.
